I would like to submit a freedom of information request under the Freedom of Information ACT 2014 in relation to the Clár Programme 2023. Funding was provided for two sites in my locality, namely (1) Catholes Falls Amenity Area and (2) Cappard Amenity area. As a resident of the area I would like to be provided with information regarding the applications made for the aforementioned sites, the plans submitted in the applications and the subsequent provisions and framework / rules for the spending of the allocated grant money and any reporting requirements etc. If reports or updates have already been submitted I also wish to receive those reports.

I recognise that the record mentioned at 3. Above may not exist on 2 January, 2024. Please either provide an analysis (if it exists) or requests received up to 30 November 2023, or (preferably) delay processing of this part of my request until an analysis of the complete year exists.
